SUMMARY OF DUTIES: Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

About Mainspring Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power.

The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together: Pragmatic Optimism Excellence without Ego Proactive Collaboration Job Overview As a Data Center Senior Sales Associate, every day will bring new opportunities to help our customers succeed.

On a daily basis, you'll dive into connecting with potential clients, nurturing initial stage pipeline and will work side by side with a team of Account Executives helping drive opportunities to close. What makes this job unique is the chance to be a part of a culture that celebrates success and learns from every challenge.

Our team is collaborative and supportive, providing you with the resources to reach your full potential. You'll be making an impact not just on our company's growth, but also on the success of our customers' businesses.

At the end of each day, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your efforts are directly contributing to the vibrant energy and success of our dynamic company.

Responsibilities Perform research on data center accounts including mapping corporate structure, identifying key decision-makers and influencers, understanding business drivers, recent initiatives, and financials Develop key relationships within engaged target accounts, conducting and facilitating conversations that will lead to new or additional opportunities within an account Act as the subject matter expert on the deal team for developing project economics and interfacing with the customer's finance and sustainability evaluators Manage the opportunity funnel with the Account Executives (AE's), ensuring deals are progressing and updated in Salesforce.com Gather and perform economic analysis aligned with customer development plans Prepare and give presentations to prospective customers Work with the prospects and the account executives to maintain mutual plans ensuring key milestones are on target Work cross-functionally with supporting teams to package solutions for customers based on Mainspring’s value props Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of sales experience, with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding quotas.

Experience within the data center, telecom, or energy industries is highly preferred Sales & Pipeline Management: Proven ability to qualify prospects, navigate the sales cycle, and run effective negotiations.

Strong pipeline discipline with a history of consistent CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred) Communication & Presence: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with a natural ability to build rapport and manage multi-stakeholder relationships Analytical Aptitude: Ability to analyze sales data, evaluate basic financial models, and adapt to evolving market trends Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field Does your experience not meet all of our posted requirements?

Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to positions unless they meet every listed requirement.

At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you.

Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background. In more traditional words, Mainspring Energy , Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

This compensation and benefits information is based on Mainspring Energy 's estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future. We generally do not negotiate on salary once we have made an offer.

About Funden: Founders think raising capital is a relationship problem. It's actually a preparation and signal problem. Funden builds the infrastructure that makes investors come to founders: a clean, investor grade deal plus a compounding public signal, instead of chasing warm intros that rarely close.

We work with a limited number of pre seed to Series B founders at a time, by application only. We'd rather tell someone we're not a fit before they apply than after. That selectivity is the backdrop for this role. You're not talking founders into something they'll regret.

You're helping serious operators decide whether an institutional grade process is worth committing to. Location: Work from anywhere. Funden operates across San Francisco, New York, and London, and this role can be based wherever you are. Compensation: Commission only, uncapped.

Warm, pre qualified inbound plus the freedom to build your own outbound pipeline. Full commission structure, ramp expectations, and average deal economics are shared transparently on the first conversation. We'd rather you have the real numbers before you invest your time than after.

About the Role: This is a full cycle sales role focused on two things: bringing in new leads and closing the inbound ones. The majority of your pipeline is warm. Founders apply through the site, self select on stage and raise size, and arrive already interested.

You'll run the interview call, pressure test the deal alongside our team, and close the founders who are genuinely a fit. Alongside that inbound engine, you'll do outbound, sourcing founders and referral relationships that match our profile, to keep the pipeline full between cohorts. You own the conversation from first call to signed engagement.

You'll turn away founders who aren't right, because a bad fit close costs us more than a missed one. This is a commission only role. There is no base salary. The trade is straightforward: uncapped earnings, warm and pre qualified inbound, a real product with real outcomes behind it, and the autonomy to run your own pipeline.

If you close, you earn, with no ceiling on how much. Your Role Responsibility:
Run discovery and qualification calls with inbound founder applicants, pressure testing narrative, stage, and readiness against our fit criteria
Close engagements with founders who are a strong fit, and confidently disqualify those who aren't
Source outbound leads: founders and referral partners such as operators, angels, and accelerators matching the pre seed to Series B profile
Own your pipeline end to end, including forecasting, follow up, and CRM hygiene
Translate a nuanced offering (audit, deal materials, and a compounding signal system) into terms a founder can act on
Feed the team real signal from the market: which objections recur, which segments convert, what founders actually respond to

Experienced in a considered, consultative B2B sale, ideally to founders, operators, or finance literate buyers
Comfortable, energized even, by a commission only structure, because you back your own ability to close
Credible in a room with founders and investors; you can hold a substantive conversation about fundraising, deal quality, and what actually moves capital
Genuinely willing to say no to a bad fit deal, and disciplined enough to protect the brand over a short term win
Self-directed: you build your own process, manage your own pipeline, and don't wait to be told what to do next

Experience in venture, startup fundraising, M&A, investment banking, or a founder facing SaaS or fintech sale
An existing network in the early-stage startup or investor ecosystem
You've raised capital yourself, or sat close enough to the process to speak to it with authority

Bei Swarovski zählen deine Ideen - und dein Beitrag sorgt dafür, dass unseren Kund\*innen jeden Tag unvergessliche Momente erleben.
Bist du bereit, mit einer der bekanntesten Marken in Mode und Design Brillanz zum Leben zu erwecken? Werde Teil unseres Retail-Teams und einer Kultur, in der Service auf Stil trifft und jede Begegnung die Eleganz und den Pop-Luxus von Swarovski widerspiegelt.
Als Sales Consultant (w/m/d) bietest du einen außergewöhnlichen Service, schaffst unvergessliche Markenerlebnisse und begeisterst Kund\*innen mit deiner Leidenschaft für unsere Produkte. Gleichzeitig erreichst du deine Verkaufsziele und trägst zu einem dynamischen Team bei.
**Über die Stelle**
* Hervorragenden Kundenservice bieten und emotionale Bindungen durch Storytelling schaffen
* Vertrauen und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen sowie Treueprogramme fördern
* Individuelle und Team-Verkaufsziele erreichen und Verantwortung für die Ergebnisse übernehmen
* Gemeinsam mit dem Team eine einladende und organisierte Ladenumgebung sicherstellen
* Über die Produkte und Marke informiert bleiben und digitale Tools nutzen, um das Kundenerlebnis zu verbessern

* Begeisterung für Mode, Luxus oder Lifestyle-Marken
* Erfahrung in einem multikulturellen Retail-Umfeld
* Ausgezeichnete und nachweisliche Fähigkeiten im Kundenservice sowie eine gewinnende Persönlichkeit, die Vertrauen schafft
* Neugierig, empathisch und ergebnisorientiert - Teamplayer mit ausgeprägtem kaufmännischem Denken
* Digital affin und sicher im Umgang mit Retail-Technologien
* Selbstbewusst darin, deine Individualität auszudrücken und kreative Ideen ins Team einzubringen
**Das bieten wir**

s.t:
* Anerkennungsprämien, die deine Leistungen würdigen
* Exklusive Rabatte für Mitarbeitende auf Swarovski-Produkte
* Bezahlte Zeit für ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten, um Dich für Herzensprojekte zu engagieren
* Kostenloser Zugang zu unserem globalen Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Professionelle Beratung und Coaching in den Bereichen mentale, körperliche und emotionale Gesundheit sowie Unterstützung bei Führungsfragen, Finanz- und Rechtsangelegenheiten.
* Umfassende Produkt- und Persönlichkeitstrainings, die dich in deiner Weiterentwicklung unterstützen

Viele unserer Sales Consultants entwickeln sich in Führungs- oder Spezialistenrollen - zum Beispiel Store Manager, Trainer oder Visual Merchandiser. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, eine Karriere aufzubauen, die zu deinen Zielen passt.
**Über Swarovski**
Swarovski kreiert Produkte aus Kristall von höchster Qualität und meisterhafter Handwerkskunst - geschaffen, um Freude zu bereiten und Individualität zu feiern. Seit unserer Gründung 1895 in Österreich entwerfen, produzieren und vertreiben wir weltweit erstklassige Kristalle, Edelsteine, Swarovski Created Diamonds, Zirkonia, Schmuck, Accessoires und Wohnobjekte.
Nachhaltigkeit und Verantwortung sind zentrale Werte unserer Marke. Von zirkulären Innovationen über Diversität und Inklusion bis hin zur philanthropischen Arbeit der Swarovski Foundation - wir bestärken Menschen darin, ihre Individualität selbstbewusst und respektvoll auszudrücken. Wir glauben fest daran, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven uns bereichern und stärker machen.
Als Arbeitgeber fördern wir Chancengleichheit und ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld. Unser Ziel ist es, faire Personalpolitik zu leben und einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem sich alle wirklich zugehörig fühlen.

High-quality fresh chocolate - that's what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are located in the canton of Glarus. Here, against a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates and are constantly developing new, innovative ideas in agile teams.
The Retail business unit comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate in ever new ways. Want to be part of it too? Come and join us.
##### What you can expect #####
* You provide customer-oriented advice and sell our wide range of products, for example when helping customers choose gifts
* You actively engage with our customers, identify their needs, and offer suitable solutions
* You handle checkout processes and ensure accurate and correct cash management
* You present our exquisite confectionery and chocolate assortment in an appealing and inviting way
* You also perform production-related tasks as well as restocking and maintaining the sales areas
* You implement our high quality standards with dedication and care
* You consistently ensure compliance with hygiene and freshness standards
* You work hand in hand with your team and contribute to a positive working atmosphere
##### What we expect from you #####
* You bring valuable professional experience in retail and have a passion for sales as well as a strong focus on closing deals
* You enjoy direct contact with customers and aim to provide them with a special shopping experience
* You quickly identify customer needs and provide tailored, friendly, and convincing advice
* You have excellent communication skills and express yourself clearly and confidently
* You speak German and English very well; French and other languages are a strong advantage and highly valued
* You consistently prioritize quality and customer focus, even in busy or high-pressure situations
* You work in a responsible, reliable, and well-structured manner
* You have a strong awareness of quality and consistently maintain hygiene and cleanliness standards
* You are happy to take responsibility, are a true team player, and are committed to shared goals
* You are motivated to further develop your skills in sales and service
* You are flexible and not hesitant to work on weekends, Saturdays, Sundays, or public holidays

About Omtera
Omtera is an AI deployment and enterprise technology company helping leading organisations across EMEA turn world-class technology into real, production-ready business solutions.

We design and deliver AI deployment, customer engagement, product analytics and work-management projects using technologies from companies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, FinAI, Braze, Snowflake, Asana, Mixpanel, OneSignal and some others.

Our teams work with globally recognised organisations including NEXT, Qatar Airways, ELM Company, Mobily, Intel and Delivery Hero , supporting complex enterprise projects from initial discovery and commercial design through implementation, adoption and expansion.

We are now looking for a commercially ambitious Sales Executive to help grow our AI and SaaS solutions business across EMEA. Tasks This is a broad, consultative sales role covering both subscription-based SaaS solutions and AI deployment projects.

You will identify potential customers, understand their business challenges, develop opportunities and work alongside Omtera ’s technical consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers to create solutions that customers can confidently buy and deploy.

Depending on your experience, you may join us as an early-career Sales Executive ready to develop quickly, or as a more experienced Account Executive capable of owning opportunities independently. This is not a scripted sales role.

You will need to understand technology, ask intelligent questions and connect customer challenges with the right commercial and technical solutions.

Approximately 50% of your working day will require fluent English , both written and spoken, including customer meetings, internal collaboration, proposals, presentations and communication with international technology partners. What You Will Do
Build and manage a pipeline of AI deployment, SaaS subscription and professional services opportunities across EMEA.
Identify and engage relevant decision-makers through outbound prospecting, networking, events, partner referrals and inbound opportunities.
Conduct discovery meetings to understand customer objectives, technical environments and commercial priorities.
Position solutions involving OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, FinAI, Braze, OneSignal, Asana, Mixpanel and other leading technology platforms.
Work closely with solution consultants and Forward-Deployed Engineers to shape proposals, demonstrations, pilots and deployment plans.
Manage the sales process from initial contact through qualification, proposal, negotiation and closing.
Develop clear commercial proposals covering subscriptions, implementation services and ongoing support.
Maintain accurate opportunity, activity and forecast information in the CRM.
Build long-term relationships with customers and identify renewal, expansion and cross-sell opportunities.
Collaborate with international partner and vendor sales teams on joint opportunities and go-to-market initiatives.
Continuously improve your understanding of AI, SaaS, enterprise technology and the industries we serve.

s.h: Requirements What We Are Looking For
s.t:
At least one year of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, partnerships or a similar customer-facing role.
Experience selling or supporting the sale of SaaS subscriptions, cloud solutions, consulting services, implementation projects or other technology solutions.
Professional-level English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
A genuine interest in AI, enterprise software and emerging technologies.
The ability to learn new products quickly and explain their business value clearly.
A proactive and disciplined approach to prospecting, follow-up and pipeline management.
Comfort working with targets and a compensation structure consisting of a base salary and performance-based commission.
Strong presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
The ability to take ownership while collaborating closely with commercial and technical teams.
You May Be a Strong Fit If
You are early in your career but have already demonstrated strong commercial potential.
You currently work as a Sales Executive, Account Executive, Business Development Representative, Sales Development Representative or Account Manager.
You want to move from selling a single product into a broader AI and enterprise technology environment.
You are commercially driven but also curious about how technology is implemented and used.
You want exposure to enterprise customers, international technology companies and complex projects.
You are looking for a role where strong performance can lead to significantly greater responsibility.

A competitive base salary with a clear performance-based commission structure.
The opportunity to sell some of the world’s most relevant AI and SaaS technologies.
Direct exposure to enterprise customers and international opportunities across EMEA.
The chance to work closely with experienced consultants, solution architects and Forward-Deployed Engineers.
Structured development across prospecting, discovery, solution selling, negotiation and enterprise account management.
Significant career progression opportunities based on performance and ownership.
Access to partner training, product certifications and industry events.
A fast-moving environment where good ideas and strong results are recognised.
The opportunity to help shape Omtera ’s growing AI deployment business.
Hiring Process Our hiring process is designed to be practical and transparent:
An introductory conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and expectations.
A commercial interview focused on your sales approach, communication skills and understanding of technology solutions.
A short practical exercise or customer scenario.
A final conversation with Omtera ’s leadership team.
You do not need to know every technology we work with before applying. We are interested in candidates who combine commercial ambition, curiosity, discipline and the ability to learn quickly. Apply If you want to build a career at the intersection of enterprise sales, SaaS and AI deployment , we would like to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV and a short note explaining why this opportunity interests you and what type of technology or solution-selling experience you would bring to Omtera . Originally posted on Himalayas

Consultant(e) stagiaire en adaptation au changement climatique (f/h/x)
Aix-en-Provence, France
Ramboll France est une société de conseil et d-ingénierie implantée à Aix-en-Provence, Paris, Bordeaux et Lyon. Ses plus de 100 collaborateurs exercent dans les domaines du climat (adaptation et atténuation), de la qualité de l-air, des sites et sols pollués, de l'audit de Due Diligence, de l'EHS (Environnement, Hygiène, Sécurité), des études d'impact internationales, des risques industriels et de la biodiversité.
Pour plus d-informations : www.ramboll.com
Au sein de l-équipe Air et Climat de Ramboll France, une dizaine de personnes se consacre à l-appui des politiques et stratégies climatiques. Elles apportent leurs expertises de conseil et de recherche aux niveaux local, national et international.

Leur champ d-expertise concerne le soutien aux décideurs publics dans le développement et la mise en œuvre des politiques d-adaptation et d-atténuation et le développement de méthodologies et de connaissances sur des leviers spécifiques de l-action climatique ou encore auprès des entreprises.
En matière d-adaptation au changement climatique, les missions de l-équipe couvrent : les diagnostics et analyses de risques climatiques (territoire ou entreprise), l-appui à la gouvernance climat, l-appui à l-élaboration de stratégies et plans d-actions à différentes échelles territoriales ou au sein de l-entreprise, le développement de cadres et outils de références, les analyses coûts-bénéfices de l-adaptation, la formation et le renforcement des capacités, l-accès aux services climatiques, et la mise en place de dispositifs de suivi-évaluation des mesures et programmes mis en œuvres.
Nous recherchons pour une durée de 6 mois un(e) stagiaire (f/h/x) en dernière année d-études d-ingénieur ou master équivalent dans le domaine de l-environnement, de l-adaptation au changement climatique, de l-économie du développement ou des sciences politiques, pour notre agence d-Aix-en-Provence.
Sous la supervision d-un tuteur de stage et de directeurs de projet, vous serez formé(e) au métier d-ingénieur de projet junior dans le domaine de l-adaptation au changement climatique.

Durant ce stage, vous serez amené(e) à travailler notamment sur les missions suivantes, en lien avec une problématique de recherche affinée avec vous en début de stage :
Principalement : la définition et la mise en plan de stratégies / plans d-actions / feuilles de route sur l-adaptation à différentes échelles (France et international), pour des publics variés (gouvernements et agences institutionnelles, collectivités locales, entreprises et filières économiques). Vous interviendrez sur les différentes étapes du cycle de projet d-adaptation :
* L-analyse de risques climatiques (en collaboration avec notre équipe de climatologues)
* La définition de trajectoires et de plans d-adaptation
* La construction de dispositifs de suivi-évaluation-rapportage

s.h: Incluant différents types de tâches, notamment

* Construction de scénarios prospectifs

* Prise en compte des enjeux croisés climat et biodiversité dans le suivi-évaluation de l-adaptation,
* Proposition de cadres de réflexion pour évaluer l-adaptation dans une perspective transformationnelle.
Vous serez également intégré(e) à différentes équipes projet et participerez à la réalisation d-analyses spécifiques en soutien des missions réalisées par l-équipe climat :
* Diagnostic de risques climatiques de territoires ou d-organisations privées,
* Appui à l-élaboration de stratégies/plans d-adaptation et approches économiques de l-adaptation (évaluation coûts-bénéfices, évaluation des coûts de l-inaction),
* Appui à l-intégration de l-adaptation dans les processus institutionnels (Contribution Déterminée Nationale (CDN), Plans Nationaux d-Adaptation, etc.),
* Appui à l-équipe atténuation sur des bilans carbone et stratégie bas-carbone,
* Participation à des études européennes sur des sujets climat.
Vous pourrez être amené(e) à participer au montage ou au développement d-offres de services sur des sujets, en lien avec l-ensemble de nos partenaires.
Au sein de l-équipe Climat de Ramboll France, construire une culture des enjeux d-atténuation et d-adaptation de haut niveau est une valeur forte : il est attendu une participation active du stagiaire à cette dynamique interne (partage d-actualités, de connaissances, de projets, etc.).

M. Dodaj, comment s'est déroulé votre premier rendez-vous ce matin ?
Ma matinée s'est très bien passée. Le premier rendez-vous consistait à présenter le SIBIR à un important propriétaire immobilier. Ce fut une rencontre agréable, au cours de laquelle j'ai réussi à susciter l'intérêt du propriétaire pour SIBIR et à le convaincre de notre offre.
Quel rôle jouez-vous en tant que responsable régional des ventes chez SIBIR ?
En tant que responsable régional des ventes, je suis chargé de l'accompagnement complet et du soutien des clients professionnels et privés dans la région de Zurich et de la Suisse centrale.

Mon domaine de responsabilité ne se limite pas seulement à l'entretien des relations clients existantes, mais inclut également la tâche cruciale d'acquérir de nouveaux clients dans ma zone de compétence.

Cette double mission exige une approche globale afin de garantir que tant les clients actuels que potentiels bénéficient du meilleur service et conseil possible.
Avec quels départements travaillez-vous particulièrement en étroite collaboration ?
Dans mon travail quotidien, je collabore étroitement avec la planification du service et le service commercial interne. L'échange régulier avec ces départements est essentiel pour assurer un traitement sans accroc.

Tant dans la planification que dans le service commercial interne, des collègues expérimentés et professionnels travaillent ensemble pour offrir un service optimal à nos clients et répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Cette coopération étroite permet une coordination efficace des processus et garantit que nous pouvons répondre de manière flexible aux besoins de nos clients.
Quelles tendances observez-vous dans les produits SIBIR ?
Les produits SIBIR mettent clairement en avant les tendances de la Swissness, de l'élégance ainsi que d'un design simple et épuré. Ces éléments représentent une promesse de qualité. La focalisation sur la simplicité et l'épuration souligne non seulement la convivialité des produits, mais reflète également un design intemporel.

Ces tendances visent à garantir que les produits SIBIR ne soient pas seulement fonctionnels, mais aussi esthétiquement attrayants et en accord avec les normes élevées de la tradition de fabrication suisse.
Et dans le domaine du service toutes marques ?
Dans l'évolution actuelle du service toutes marques, des tendances claires se dégagent. Un souhait croissant des clients est de recevoir tous les services regroupés et fournis par un seul interlocuteur. La nécessité d'avoir un point de contact unique pour divers besoins prend de plus en plus d'importance.

Il est notable que le prix n'est souvent plus au centre des préoccupations. Les clients accordent plutôt une importance accrue à un traitement professionnel et efficace de leurs demandes, ce qui est considéré comme une valeur ajoutée.

Cela illustre un déplacement des considérations purement financières vers un accent renforcé sur la qualité globale du service et la simplicité du traitement.
Comment percevez-vous vos clients, qu'ils soient administrations ou particuliers ?
Mes expériences avec mes clients, qu'il s'agisse d'administrations ou de particuliers, sont globalement positives. Je suis heureux de pouvoir dire que j'entretiens des relations très agréables avec nos clients chez SIBIR.

La collaboration avec les administrations et les particuliers se déroule de manière positive, et j'apprécie la possibilité de contribuer à leur satisfaction. Je me réjouis de continuer à soutenir nos clients avec enthousiasme à l'avenir et de poursuivre ces expériences positives de collaboration.
Cela nécessite certainement des mesures de vente individuelles. Les développez-vous seul ?
Nous disposons de cadres très expérimentés qui nous soutiennent à un niveau élevé. Lors du développement des mesures de vente, il est toutefois important de noter que chaque client a des besoins différents. Il est donc indispensable d'être flexible et d'utiliser les mesures de vente appropriées au bon moment. Cela exige de chaque membre de l'équipe de la sensibilité et de la flexibilité.
Concernant la durabilité : comment pourrait-on économiser davantage de CO2 ?
Spécialement dans le contexte des appareils ménagers, je souhaite souligner les points suivants : prolongation de la durée de vie des appareils : la garantie des pièces détachées de SIBIR suit déjà une voie très positive avec nos clients. Pas moins de 70 % de tous les appareils sont réparés et non remplacés.

En favorisant une durée de vie plus longue et en garantissant la disponibilité des pièces détachées, nous contribuons activement à réduire l'empreinte écologique et à minimiser les émissions de CO2.

Ces approches durables sont non seulement en accord avec les objectifs environnementaux, mais démontrent également notre engagement commun pour un avenir respectueux des ressources.
La réparation des machines cassées a-t-elle aujourd'hui une plus grande importance ?
Absolument. Cette évolution est perceptible pour moi personnellement et je la perçois de manière positive. Une tendance claire se manifeste dans la préférence de nos clients pour les réparations plutôt que pour l'achat immédiat d'un nouvel appareil.

Cela souligne non seulement une conscience environnementale accrue, mais reflète également une valorisation croissante des pratiques durables. L'importance accrue accordée à la réparation des machines cassées se reflète donc non seulement dans ma perception personnelle, mais est également clairement soulignée par les préférences de notre clientèle.
Quel était votre métier de rêve enfant ?
Enfant, mon métier de rêve était policier. Mais au fil du temps, j'ai développé un fort intérêt pour une activité dans la vente. J'ai finalement pu réaliser ce rêve chez SIBIR.
